title: Max Is Not Big
cover: Max the pug. Big, simple and friendly.

pages.beat: Max beside a small round dog bed.
Max sinking into the bed, blissful.

pages.text: Max is snug in the bed.
pages.beat: Max tucked in with a blanket.

pages.text: Bump! Bob is on the bed.
pages.beat: Bob landing on the bed, Max squashed.

pages.text: Then Tip. Then Mim. Then Pip.
pages.beat: Tip, Mim and Pip piling onto the bed.
Bob shuffling over on the bed to make room, Max, Tip, Mim and Pip squeezed beside him.
Max, Bob, Tip, Mim and Pip all together on one bed, squashed and happy.

pages.text: The bed is soft. Max is snug.
pages.beat: Bob, Tip, Mim and Pip piled on the bed, Max at the bottom smiling.

pages.text: Nap, Max. Nap, Bob, Tip, Mim and Pip.
pages.beat: All asleep in a heap on the bed.

framing: Composition: the plain cream background fills the whole frame edge to edge with no border, frame line, margin or vignette.
